# Heath & City Technology Hampstead

> Private Information Technology (IT) and document systems for boutique
> professional practices in Hampstead, North West (NW) London and The City:
> barristers and King's Counsel (KC), single-family offices and private
> trustees, surgeons and medical consultants, prime estate agents and
> surveyors, commercial insurance brokers, stockbrokers and investment
> managers, chartered accountants and tax advisers, and composers and music
> publishers. Client, patient and fund records are never uploaded to public
> Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools; systems run on sovereign hardware in the
> client's office or in a private UK data vault. Technology and administrative
> services only; no legal, medical, investment or insurance advice.

## Details

- Website: https://heathandcity.com/
- Address: Corringham Court, Corringham Road, London NW11 7BY
- Areas served: NW3, NW6, NW8, NW11, N6 and the City of London
- Telephone: 020 4520 9114
- Email: contactus@heathandcity.com

## Target Client Practices

1. **Barristers & King's Counsel (KC):** Precedent and brief discovery across
   decades of files; court disclosure bundle cross-referencing.
2. **Single-Family Offices & Private Trustees:** Multi-custodian statement
   consolidation, capital call tracking, and estate disbursement auditing.
3. **Surgeons & Medical Consultants:** Chronology generation from 2,000+ page
   medico-legal bundles; insurer underpayment recovery checks.
4. **Prime Estate Agents & Surveyors:** Sales progression tracking,
   Anti-Money Laundering (AML) source-of-funds checks, and tenancy compliance.
5. **Commercial Insurance Brokers:** 90-day policy renewal tracking,
   underwriter warranty alterations, and client valuation chasers.
6. **Stockbrokers & Wealth Managers:** Contract note settlement matching,
   corporate action deadline monitoring, and mandate suitability reviews.
7. **Chartered Accountants & Tax Advisers:** Corporation tax statutory
   filings, Self-Assessment dividend voucher tracking, and VAT gateway receipts.
8. **Composers & Music Publishers:** Collection-society statement matching,
   writer split verification, and commission deliverable deadlines.

## Fixed Fees

- Two-week trial on your own documents: GBP 750 to 1,500
- Full set-up in your office: GBP 3,000 to 10,000+ (three to six weeks)
- Ongoing local care: GBP 350 to 1,200 a month, cancel with notice
